articles.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

articles.title: Former Point72 head of proprietary research says AI could turn data into a new asset class for Wall Street
articles.snippet: A former Point72 executive says AI could reshape Wall Street's data market, turning once-exclusive information into a source of revenue and financing.

articles.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
articles.snippet: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $59,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
articles.snippet: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

articles.title: ECB’s Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market
articles.snippet: The ECB president called for common rules as the EU's new blockchain settlement system handled a 1 billion-euro ($1.1 billion) digital bond transaction.
